options.name: ca_path
options.description: The CA bundle to use for https connections.

options.name: config
options.description: The raw configuration to use for the chosen auth method. Contents vary depending upon the O(type) chosen. Required when the auth method is created.

options.name: description
options.description: Free form human readable description of the auth method.

options.name: display_name
options.description: An optional name to use instead of O(name) when displaying information about this auth method.

options.name: max_token_ttl
options.description: This specifies the maximum life of any token created by this auth method. Can be specified in the form of V(60s) or V(5m) (that is, 60 seconds or 5 minutes, respectively).

options.name: name
options.description: Specifies a name for the ACL auth method. The name can contain alphanumeric characters, dashes C(-), and underscores C(_).

options.name: port
options.description: The port on which the consul agent is running.

options.name: scheme
options.description: The protocol scheme on which the Consul agent is running. Defaults to V(http) and can be set to V(https) for secure connections.

options.name: state
options.description: Whether the token should be present or absent.

options.name: token
options.description: The token to use for authorization.

options.name: token_locality
options.description: Defines the kind of token that this auth method should produce.

options.name: type
options.description: The type of auth method being configured. This field is immutable. Required when the auth method is created.

options.name: validate_certs
options.description: Whether to verify the TLS certificate of the Consul agent.
